title: Single-complex normalization of a target transition
statement: For arbitrary schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], a commutative coefficient ring Λ, and étale Λ-module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], use the canonical inverse images and composition comparisons [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] and the canonical degree-q higher-image triangle transitions [def-sbc-module-higher-image-transitions]. Let e:Y→T, h:Y→X, π:T′→T, a:Y′→Y, e′:Y′→T′ and h′:Y′→X satisfy a ≫ e=e′ ≫ π and a ≫ h=h′. Let F be a sheaf on T, F′ on T′ and f:π*F→F′. For every integer q, the target transition [def-sbc-canonical-base-change-stalk-transitions] followed by the target-functor map of f and the exact single-complex comparison at e′ equals the exact comparison at e followed by the higher-image transition along a and the higher-image map of δ. Here δ:a*e*F→e′*F′ is the inverse (a,e) composition comparison, followed by the (e′,π) comparison transported using a ≫ e=e′ ≫ π, followed by e′*(f).

source.place: Tags 0F07 (lemma-go-down-to-field), coefficient identification preceding condition (2), and 09Z1, canonical restriction maps.

proof.text: Expand the target transition and its single-complex comparisons. Naturality of the derived triangle transition moves the source comparison across the transition. Compatibility of exact pullback composition with placing F in degree zero turns the derived coefficient square into the single functor applied to δ; transports along the arrow equality agree by proof irrelevance. Apply the target derived direct image and degree-q homology, then use naturality for the final coefficient map f. This is precisely the normalization equality, independently of q or cartesianness. The target functor comparison is written with explicit higher-image object types using baseChangeTargetFunctorHigherImageIso; this is the same existing exact single-complex isomorphism.

lean.statement: theorem baseChangeTargetTransition_higherImage {X T Y T' Y' : Scheme.{u}} (e : Y ⟶ T) (h : Y ⟶ X) (q : ℤ) (π : T' ⟶ T) (a : Y' ⟶ Y) (e' : Y' ⟶ T') (h' : Y' ⟶ X) (wa : a ≫ e = e' ≫ π) (wh : a ≫ h = h') (F : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (F' : Sheaf T'.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (f : ((π)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj F ⟶ F') : baseChangeTargetTransition Λ e h q π a e' h' wa wh F ≫ (baseChangeTargetFunctor Λ e' h' q).map f ≫ (baseChangeTargetFunctorHigherImageIso Λ e' h' q F').hom = (baseChangeTargetFunctorHigherImageIso Λ e h q F).hom ≫ higherDirectImageTransition Λ a h h' wh q (((e)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj F) ≫ higherDirectImageMap Λ h' q ((upperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) a e).inv.app F ≫ (upperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) e' π (a ≫ e) wa).hom.app F ≫ ((e')^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).map f)
